title: Kerala Backwaters Escape
summary: Drift through palm-lined canals on a private houseboat, then unwind in the misty tea hills of Munnar.
description: A slow, scenic loop through God’s Own Country: Kochi’s spice-scented old town, the green tea estates of Munnar, and an overnight houseboat cruise on the Alleppey backwaters with home-style Kerala meals on board.

images.alt: Traditional houseboat on palm-fringed Kerala backwaters
Houseboat cruising a wide palm-lined backwater channel in Kerala

itinerary.description: Airport pickup, check-in and an evening walk through Fort Kochi’s Chinese fishing nets.

itinerary.description: Scenic drive past waterfalls into the tea country; afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: Munnar tea trails
itinerary.description: Guided tea-estate walk and a visit to Eravikulam National Park.

itinerary.title: Alleppey houseboat
itinerary.description: Board a private houseboat for an overnight cruise through the backwaters.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.description: Disembark after breakfast and transfer to Kochi airport.

title: Bali Island Romance
summary: Private pool villas in Ubud, cliff-top sunsets at Uluwatu and a candlelit beach dinner for two.
description: Designed for couples: three nights among Ubud’s rice terraces and jungle temples, followed by a beachside stay in Seminyak with a sunset Kecak performance and a private dinner on the sand.

title: Maldives Overwater Luxury
summary: Four nights in an overwater villa with seaplane transfers, house-reef snorkelling and all-inclusive dining.
description: Step from your deck straight into the lagoon. This all-inclusive island stay pairs seaplane arrivals with guided snorkelling, a sandbank picnic and a sunset dolphin cruise.

itinerary.title: Dolphin sunset
itinerary.description: Spa morning and an evening dolphin-spotting cruise.

itinerary.title: Depart

title: Swiss Alps Explorer
summary: Glacier hikes, cogwheel railways and the waterfall valley of Lauterbrunnen on a Swiss Travel Pass.
description: An active alpine week from Zurich to the Bernese Oberland: ride panoramic trains, hike above Grindelwald, take a cable car to the Schilthorn and paddle on Lake Brienz.

itinerary.description: Hike among 72 waterfalls and visit Trümmelbach Falls.

itinerary.title: Schilthorn summit

title: Goa Weekend Beach Break
summary: A breezy long weekend of North Goa beaches, Old Goa churches and a sunset river cruise.
description: Perfect for a quick reset: stay near Candolim beach, explore UNESCO-listed Old Goa, sample Goan cuisine at a heritage home and cruise the Mandovi at sunset.
